tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand plum. Main buttons, active nav, selected states, the search focus accent.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, selected chips, the search field fill.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet actions, secondary icons, filter chip outlines.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Neutral chips, segmented controls, unselected toggles.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Links, keyboard focus ring, informational accents. Kept away from the risk hues on purpose.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Info banners, tips, the selected-area highlight chip.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the app shell behind the map.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Cards, the search field, the area bottom sheet: the raised layer.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, the sunken layer under cards.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surfaces.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper copy.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Input borders, dividers that must be seen, area outlines on the map.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and failed loads only. Never used for risk.

tokens.name: risk-low
tokens.usage: Low theft risk tier: map fill, legend swatch, tier chip.

tokens.name: risk-medium
tokens.usage: Medium theft risk tier.

tokens.name: risk-high
tokens.usage: High theft risk tier.

tokens.name: risk-no-data
tokens.usage: Limited data. Always drawn with the diagonal hatch and a dashed outline, never as a flat fill.

tokens.name: cb-risk-low
tokens.usage: Low tier when the colour-blind palette is on. Blue.

tokens.name: cb-risk-medium
tokens.usage: Medium tier when the colour-blind palette is on. Amber. In dark it reads a little olive: revisit if it muddies.

tokens.name: cb-risk-high
tokens.usage: High tier when the colour-blind palette is on. Orange. Differs from blue in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: map-shadow
tokens.usage: Dark end of the basemap duotone tint.

tokens.name: map-highlight
tokens.usage: Light end of the basemap duotone tint.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and an expanded bottom sheet.

styles.name: headline-md
styles.usage: Page titles and the big highlight figure.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Area name in the bottom sheet.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Eyebrows and uppercase tags. Never for the only copy of a fact.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: Planning-area IDs, counts, percentages. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Atkinson draws a slashed zero, which keeps 0 and O apart in IDs.

styles.name: attribution-sm
styles.usage: Data and map credits only (Polizei Berlin, OpenStreetMap contributors). Kept visible at all times; no other use.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control, between legend entries.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip and input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between related groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom rhythm.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Map polygons and full-bleed images.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, tooltips, legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of the bottom sheet, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the search pill, toggles, avatars.

shadow.note: Plum-tinted in light, plain black in dark. In dark, elevation is mostly carried by a lighter surface, so the shadows are only a supporting cue.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flat. Page and the map layer.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards resting on the surface, chips.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Search field, map controls, hovered cards.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, popovers.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Dialogs, snackbars.

tokens.name: elevation-5
tokens.usage: Drag previews and the largest overlays.

tokens.name: elevation-sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet, cast upward over the map.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any control. A 2px gap in the surface colour, then a 2px tertiary ring.

borderWidth.note: Borders are used for definition, shadows for lift. A control that sits on a surface gets a border, a floating one gets a shadow.

tokens.name: border-0
tokens.usage: No border.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Cards, dividers, polygon outlines (non-scaling).

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, outlined buttons, the selected polygon outline.

tokens.name: border-3
tokens.usage: Emphasis only: active tab indicator, error summary.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and dense toolbar buttons (padded out to the tap target).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Search field and primary calls to action.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons in text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and chips.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Standalone icons, map controls.

tokens.name: sheet-handle-w
tokens.usage: Width of the bottom sheet drag handle.

tokens.name: sheet-handle-h
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom sheet drag handle.

tokens.name: legend-swatch
tokens.usage: Square legend swatch for a risk tier.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest content column on desktop.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and their text.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer over a control on hover.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: State layer on keyboard focus.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer while pressed.

mapStyle.note: Rules for the Leaflet layer. The streets must stay readable, so polygon fills stay low even when selected.

tokens.name: map-fill-light
tokens.usage: Resting polygon fill opacity in light theme.

tokens.name: map-fill-dark
tokens.usage: Resting polygon fill opacity in dark theme.

tokens.name: map-fill-boost
tokens.usage: Added to the resting opacity on hover and selection.

tokens.name: map-fill-max
tokens.usage: Ceiling for any polygon fill opacity.

tokens.name: map-stroke-light
tokens.usage: Polygon outline opacity in light theme.

tokens.name: map-stroke-dark
tokens.usage: Polygon outline opacity in dark theme.

tokens.name: map-tint-strength
tokens.usage: Basemap duotone tint, both themes.

tokens.name: hatch-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the limited-data diagonal hatch.

tokens.name: hatch-line
tokens.usage: Line width of the hatch.

tokens.name: hatch-angle
tokens.usage: Hatch rotation in degrees.

tokens.name: dash-limited
tokens.usage: Dash pattern for the outline of limited-data areas.

tokens.usage: Page content and the map container.

tokens.name: z-map-controls
tokens.usage: Zoom and locate buttons above Leaflet's own panes.

tokens.name: z-search

tokens.name: z-sheet

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Snackbars.

tokens.usage: State layers, hover colour.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, polygon highlight.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet and dialog movement.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing curve.
